Subject: Zichang buckwheat pancakes (子长煎饼) from northern Shaanxi: several very thin soft off-white rectangular buckwheat pancakes rolled into narrow short cylinders around a modest filling of finely shredded potato and small vegetable strips; two rolls open at one end showing the subtle filling.
